Frequently asked questions

Is WinSend safe?

Local files go directly between devices, but the local HTTP path is not end-to-end encrypted. Use a trusted private network. Optional cloud clipboard encrypts text on the clients; usage analytics are separate.

Does WinSend require internet?

Local transfers require a reachable LAN, running apps and the relevant permissions; a wired PC on the same LAN also works. Client isolation or firewall rules can block access. Cloud clipboard additionally needs internet access.

What can I transfer?

WinSend transfers photos, videos and files over LAN, and clipboard text locally or with optional Cloud Sync. Source apps or system export may change the file representation.

Can I use WinSend on different networks?

Yes. Enable cloud clipboard sync to share copied text when both devices have internet access. Files and photos still require a local network connection.

Can cloud clipboard transfer files or photos?

Cloud transfer supports clipboard text. Files and photos still transfer over your local network.

Does cloud clipboard need setup?

Yes. Open Cloud Sync on Windows, then enter the pairing code in WinSend’s Cloud Sync screen on iPhone and follow the in-app instructions.
